[[File:Darth_Wredd_starship.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Wredd's starship escapes Mala]]
The rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Wredd]] owned a '''[[Starship/Legends|starship]]''' between [[138 ABY|138]] and [[139 ABY]]. It had previously belonged to his [[Darth Wredd's master|Sith master]], whom he killed during an ambush in the [[Surd Nebula/Legends|Surd Nebula]]. Wredd and his master used this starship to shoot down the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Yalta Val]]'s shuttle, which crash-landed on the floating world of [[Mala (planet)|Mala]]. Following the [[Carreras Incident]], Wredd used his starship to escape the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]]. He then embarked on an [[Darth Wredd's insurgency|insurgency]] against the [[One Sith]], killing several Sith infiltrators. Later, he used his starship to escape [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with the Imperial [[Jao Assam]], whom he intended to recruit as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. Darth Wredd used this starship to travel to Mala with Jao, where he laid a trap for both the [[Imperial Knight]]s and the [[One Sith]]; which culminated in the [[Battle of the Floating World]].
